## Checklist

- [ ] The title is a [conventional commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `perf:`, `refactor:`, `docs:`, `test:`, `build:`, `ci:`, `chore:`) that reads as the changelog entry. It becomes the squash commit.
- [ ] One coherent change; unrelated fixes are in their own pull requests.
- [ ] The repository's checks pass locally, and new logic has tests.
- [ ] A README or `docs/` page this change makes wrong is updated here.
- [ ] Everything is in English, with no AI credits and no agent files, as [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Project-Colony/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) asks.
